name: Lot escape
summary: A sliding-block puzzle in a parking lot drawn from above: drag the parked cars along their lanes until the friend's car can drive out the gate. Moves count, par is the true minimum, three lots from the chat, and each lot shows the friends' best under it.
useWhen: the sube is boxed in at lot c again, make it a game
rush hour puzzle but it's our parking lot
will can't get out after the game lol
a puzzle for the group with a leaderboard
move-in day traffic but make it a game
dontUseWhen: planning who drives or rides (use carpool)

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'Get the Sube out'

hero.description: The car being freed, e.g. 'the Sube'

levels.description: Up to 3 lots from the chat. rows: 6 strings of 6; '.' empty, 'XX' the hero on row 3, other letters are cars 2 or 3 long; cars maps a letter to a short label; the lot must be solvable

board.description: Friends' best solves: name, lot number from 1, moves, and an optional line in their words
